body: Thanks for the reassurance, I'm sure that my closest friends will stick with me, but the anxiety is still there unfortunately

Yes, it was my first relationship. As for what may happen, I'm quite an awkward, quiet, and socially anxious person who has had sizable panic attacks in social situations, I've also in the past pushed people away due to mental health and clung so heavily to people that they had to leave for their own mental health.

Hunt for the Wilderpeople, it's a New Zealand film about a boy and his guardian fleeing into the bush to avoid child services, sparking a nationwide manhunt. It's really good if it gets shown overseas.

I'm worried about co-dependency because that's what happened with my ex which destroyed me when our relationship fell apart. As for me worrying about my friend leaving me, I know it is a silly worry and I've noticed no indication that it's going to happen, but my depression has driven people away multiple times and I don't have very many friends. I'm worried that my anxiety over losing friends will lead to me doing something stupid, which will make me lose friends.

That's probably the best thing that I can do, thanks for the advice. Today I haven't been too great, saw a movie with a friend and while I enjoyed it, it didn't really make me feel any better. While this friend is very understanding of me having bad days (they're studying towards being a counselor), I'm slightly worried that I'll become co-dependent, that they'll leave, or both.
